newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL PALM OIL CLOSES UP ON REFINERS COVERING.
newsitem.headline: KL PALM OIL CLOSES UP ON REFINERS COVERING.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Oct (3rd pos) 1,220 rgt/tonne Aug (south) 1,250 *
Open/Hi/Low 1,196/1,221/1,196 Prev close 1,235
Prev settlement 1,205 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market ended firmer on active covering by refiners, technical buying and expectation of a large Aug 1-10 exports. Trading was volatile particularly in late trading after Oct futures broke the 1,210 resistance. Oct futures range next week seen at 1,200-1,250, but will depend on the ringgit performance.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Active refiner covering for products.
The contract rose to a high of 1,221 ringgit before closing the day at 1,220 ringgit ($460.38) a tonne, up 15 ringgit from Thursday's close.
"As prices have suddenly risen so much, we are unsure of the market trend in the immediate trend. Some profit-taking is expected to come in early next week," a trader said.
Next week's trend will depend on the outcome of the August 1-20 palm oil exports data, traders said.
"Some speculative buying emerged as people are predicting good exports," another trader said.
The continuing weakness in ringgit against the U.S. dollar had also prompted demand, traders said, adding that major buyers like Pakistan, India and China were seen entering the market.
Turnover on the futures market was 2,246 lots.
The physical sector reported more buying among nearby crude palm oil and RBD palm olein.
Physicals Aug (south) was offered at 1,250 ringgit a tonne against bids of 1,247.50. It was traded at 1,240 and 1,247.50.
Aug (central) saw offers at 1,235 against bids of 1,225 with trades done at 1,220 and 1,225.
Sep (south) saw offers at 1,250 ringgit against bids of 1,247.50 with trades done at 1,240 and 1,247.50.
In refined palm oil, Aug RBD palm oil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Sep at $497.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $497.50.
Aug RBD palm olein saw offers at $542.50, Sep at $540 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $537.50. Sep was traded from $532.50 to $537.50, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $530 and $535.
Aug and Sep RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $370.
Aug/Sep RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $290.
